steps.label: Prep for Cosmo Dive #2
steps.note:
Party rotate one more step over and stay on the ring or slightly in of boss hitbox
- This is a good place for both Melees to rip their LB3s

steps.note:

- Furthest player (should be OT)

Party stay within boss hitbox

steps.label: Prep for Cosmo Meteor
steps.note:
After the last 2 autos, everyone stack mid to prepare for Cosmo Meteor

- Find your waymark and be ready to spread to it after the baited AOEs spawn
- Pop your party mit as you spread

steps.label: Cosmo Meteor (baited aoes)
steps.note:
Spread to your clockspots
- You do not need to hit the meteors since Caster LB and Ranged LB will kill them naturally

steps.label: Caster LB3 asap
steps.note:
Caster must LB3 as soon as they get to their clockspot

MT and Phys Ranged must swap clockspots (N and NE) to naturally resolve Ranged LB3 spacing

steps.label: Healer step in for HEALS
steps.note: You can send your regen healer to the center to ensure that everyone is topped before the double spread AOEs

steps.label: Ranged LB3
steps.note:
Each player will get hit by 2 spread AOE meteors at random:

- Stay spread until Flares spawn

steps.label: [If Phys Ranged doesn't get Flare...]
steps.note:
Once Flares spawn, check if the Phys Ranged got one.

If Phys Ranged doesn't get Flare..
- Party stack NORTH with him

steps.label: Flares (no phys ranged Flare)
steps.note: Be intelligent with spreading these flares away from mid

steps.label: Flares + Stack
steps.note: GET BAPPED BETCH I HOPE YOU'RE ALL TOPPED

steps.label: [But if Phys Ranged gets Flare...]
steps.note:
But if Phys Ranged does get a Flare...
- Party stack SOUTH away from him

steps.label: Flares (phys ranged flare)
steps.note: Be intelligent with spreading these flares away from mid

steps.label: Flares + Stack
steps.note: GET BAPPED BYYYETCH I HOPE YOU'RE TOPPED HERE

steps.label: Tank LB3/Heal LB3 enrage
steps.note:
Magic Numbers enrage sequence!

1. 1st Magic Number
- Tank 1 must LB3 as soon as cast begins (ASAP)
- Healer 1 must WAIT until Magic Number debuff is applied before using LB3

2. Magic Number #2
- Tank 2 must LB3 as soon as cast begins (ASAP)
- Healer 2 must WAIT until Magic Number debuff is applied before using LB3

KILL BOSS! GOOD LUCK
